scorecard.name: Branding and Survey Check
scorecard.coaching: You failed the mandatory branding script: you opened with 'Hello, thanks for calling S-Net customer service' instead of 'Thank you for calling S-Net', and closed with 'Thanks for being with S-Net' instead of 'Thank you for choosing S-Net'.

scorecard.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
scorecard.coaching: When Astrid explained with obvious distress at [00:08] and [02:00] that an unexpected £18 price hike severely impacted her pension and grocery budget, you jumped straight to citing contract clauses and Ofcom regulations without validating or acknowledging her financial worry.

scorecard.name: Paraphrasing
scorecard.coaching: You never paraphrased the customer's contract pricing dispute in your own words.

scorecard.name: Probing
scorecard.coaching: You asked no diagnostic probing questions regarding the customer's usage, needs, or contract expectations, jumping directly to the retention tier.

grader.scenario: Unexpected out-of-contract price rise of £18/mo and dispute over promotional contract terms

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: Agent opened with 'Hello, thanks for calling S-Net customer service' (missing verbatim 'Thank you for calling S-Net') and closed with 'Thanks for being with S-Net' (missing verbatim 'Thank you for choosing S-Net'). Both fail the strict branding rule.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Two managed holds announced ('Bear with me for a couple of minutes', 'Give me a moment') and properly thanked without unmanaged gaps.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: Verified postal address and security question answer at [00:35], within the first 240 seconds.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: Agent addressed Astrid by name naturally multiple times throughout the call.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: Hard-case FAIL: Customer expressed acute financial worry and distress over her pension and grocery budget at [00:08] and [02:00], but Agent offered no empathy, apology, or validation, immediately quoting clause 8.2 and regulatory rules.

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Agent never restated the dispute or fee grievance in his own words.

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: Agent did not repeat any questions and accurately tracked details provided by the customer.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: Agent took ownership of applying the £18 goodwill credit and setting up the new 24-month retention contract without passing the customer to retentions or complaints.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: Hard-case PASS: While brisk, direct, and citing contractual clauses, the Agent remained professional, polite, and calm without becoming rude or sarcastic.

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: Agent asked no diagnostic probing questions regarding Astrid's broadband usage, device requirements, or contract needs.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: Customer explicitly confirmed at [13:17] that the £18 refund credit and £31/month renewal completely resolved her query and met her expectations.
